title: BAGMAN Provenance
description: Canonical `Provenance` edge (PID §11). Lets BAGMAN answer 'where did this information come from?' by tracing a derived/canonical fact (the `subject`) back to the single `EvidenceItem` it was observed, extracted, derived, or generated from. This is a platform-level, domain-agnostic primitive — not hardcoded to invoice-oriented provenance. Each `Provenance` record traces to exactly ONE `evidence_id`. Where a subject has multiple evidence sources, this is represented as MULTIPLE `Provenance` records (one per contributing evidence item), never as a single record carrying an array of evidence IDs.

provenance_id.description: Canonical BAGMAN identifier for this provenance edge.

subject_type.description: The canonical BAGMAN object type this provenance edge is about, e.g. `EvidenceItem`, `Classification`. Deliberately an open string, not a closed enum.

subject_id.description: Canonical identifier of the subject object (of type `subject_type`) that this provenance edge is about.

evidence_id.description: Canonical identifier of the ONE `EvidenceItem` this specific provenance edge traces to. Where a subject is supported by multiple evidence items, represent that as multiple `Provenance` records, not as an array on this field.

relationship.description: The nature of the relationship between `subject` and `evidence_id`. This is a CLOSED, platform-level, domain-agnostic vocabulary (PID §11 does not ask for this field to be extensible, unlike `entity_type` / `source_type` / `evidence_type` / `status` elsewhere in these contracts), so it is expressed as a JSON Schema `enum` rather than an open pattern string.

transform_id.description: Optional canonical identifier of the process/transform that produced this derivation, if any. `null` (or the key omitted) means no transform is recorded, e.g. for a direct `OBSERVED_FROM` relationship.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp at which this provenance edge was recorded.

metadata.description: Free-form, genuinely open metadata about this provenance edge.
